description: This file is a shell script for setting up and testing a Git repository with complex criss-cross merge history, including creating branches, making commits, and performing merges to test recursive merge behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expected to fail, used here for git merge conflicts.
